- Player controls are now arranged in Settings instead of by dragging them in the player, and any button can go to the top-right corner, the bottom-right corner, the menu, or be hidden, with reordering inside each area
- The customize page previews the portrait bar, the landscape bar, and the menu grid, so a layout can be checked without opening a video
- Player menus are now frosted-glass floating panels instead of the old overlay cards
- Picture-in-picture can now use an app-drawn floating window instead of the system one
- Video filters now take effect on HDR videos without waiting for the first frame
- The player now keeps only the modern layout, so the controls style and icon style options are no longer offered

---

- 播放器控件改成在设置里编排，不再靠在播放器上拖动；任意按钮都能放到右上角、右下角、菜单里，或者干脆隐藏，每个区域内还能调顺序
- 自定义页面可以预览竖屏控制栏、横屏控制栏和菜单面板，不用打开视频就能看效果
- 播放器菜单从原来的卡片改成了磨砂玻璃质感的悬浮面板
- 画中画可以改用应用自绘的悬浮窗，不再只有系统样式
- HDR 视频的滤镜不用等第一帧就能生效
- 播放器只保留现代布局，控制栏样式和图标风格的选项不再提供
